data.randomization_design: There are eight distinct matched blocks,each containing two distinct plants. Within each block a fair independent coin assigns one plant to armA and the other to armB. All six readouts are measured on those same plants;the same within-block label swap therefore changes the signs of ALL six paired differences together. Blocks have independent assignment coins. Rows must be associated by block_id,not table position. No Gaussian error model or independence of readouts is assumed.
data.sharp_null: The global sharp null states that every plant would have the same value of every listed readout under either arm. It supports exact within-block label-swap randomization inference for this finite blocked experiment. A non-rejection is not evidence that all effects are zero,and a global rejection would not establish an effect in every readout.
data.statistic_policy: For readout j let d_ij=armA-armB within block i. Use S_j=(sum_i d_ij)^2/sum_i(d_ij^2),with S_j=0only if the entire difference column is zero. Let M=max_j S_j. For every joint assignment use ONE shared sign per block across all readouts. Marginal two-sided p-values count assignments with S_j at least its observed value;the global p-value counts assignments with M at least observed M. Include ties and the observed assignment. Use exact enumeration,or an explicitly justified complete extreme-assignment certificate;MonteCarlo plus-one corrections and independent marginal histograms do not define this exact joint p-value. A1e-12absolute score tie tolerance may be used solely for floating roundoff.
data.reporting: Report minimum_unadjusted_p_value,observed_global_max_score,global_sharp_null_p_value,global_sharp_null_rejected and any_unadjusted_test_rejects. The unadjusted flag describes a diagnostic at the same stated significance level,not a familywise-valid conclusion. Reject when the relevant p-value is at most the supplied level. Numeric answers use1e-8absolute plus1e-7relative accuracy;Booleans are exact. No individual effect direction or population extrapolation is requested.

provenance.kind: Project-authored controlled blocked-plant readout panel,not observed experiment data or a cultivation protocol.
provenance.method_read_scope: Official1.15.3 paired sample-label permutation definitions and exact2**nassignments. Project-defined joint max-score/inclusive squared-statistic tails are explicit;not an assertion that the default SciPy two-sided convention is identical.
